race.comment: SUBSIDING (12) trialled smartly prior to her debut back in March but she couldn't get involved. Has been fitted with two trials in readiness and is from a leading stable. Bold showing anticipated. BELLE OLE (10) is an Ole Kirk filly on debut for the Campton yard after being bought for a pretty penny. Has trialled well in readiness and can overcome the tricky draw. BAY OF THE SOUTH (1) kicked off the prep with two encouraging efforts but was less effective last time at Ipswich. Likely improver that's worth forgiving. DIVINELLE (2) was in contention on the corner and finished second last start over 1000m at Dalby. Must raise the bar but is in the mix.
